name: YITAMOTOR LED DRL Replacement Headlights Compatible with 2007-2013 GMC Sierra 1500 2500HD 3500HD, Black Housing Headlamp Assembly, Driver & Passenger Side
fitment:
For 2007-2013 GMC Sierra 1500
For 2007-2014 GMC Sierra 2500 HD
For 2007-2014 GMC Sierra 3500 HD
(Don't compatible with 2500 HD classic)
Feature
Boost visibility with style: LED daytime running lamp dramatically improves the appearance of your vehicle and provides better illumination for greater driving safety and increased visibility
Waterproof: fully sealed with solid silicon & designed with one-way vents to prevent moisture from being trapped inside the housing, no corrosion or moisture worries in sorts of weather conditions
Brighter lighting: the metallic parabolic reflectors provide more light output to create a broader and smoother beam, and the anti-glare hood helps focus the light and makes lighting more uniform
Safety reflector: the sided micro-prism reflector makes the oncoming cars or passersby quickly notice you at night, ensuring your driving safety and others'
Impact resistance: the polycarbonate lens & tough housing are highly resistant to shock, and vibration for any tough road; professional installation would be highly recommended
